text: Boiling the milk down thickens it before a dahi starter sours it, and in trials 10–12 % sugar gave the best sweetened curd (more sugar slowed setting). Unglazed clay pots draw off water as it sets, which makes it denser still.

steps.note: Jaggery (gur) or date molasses may be used instead.
The milk is soured by a starter of dahi (yoghurt), traditionally overnight in earthenware pots.

processing.text: The FAO route adds 6.0–6.5 % cane sugar before boiling, cools to 40–45 °C and incubates for 12–15 h.
